name: Product of Array Except Self
description: Given an integer array nums, return an array answer such that answer[i] is equal to the product of all the elements of nums except nums[i]. You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time and without using the division operator.
shortDescription: Return array where each element is product of all others

methods.name: computeWithPrefixSuffix
methods.label: Prefix suffix

methods.name: computeWithOptimizedSpace
methods.label: Optimized space

methods.name: computeWithRecursion
methods.label: Recursion

explanation.idea: The product of everything except nums[i] is (everything to its left) × (everything to its right). Build those two running products and multiply them.
explanation.analogy: Standing in a queue: the people in front of you and the people behind you together are "everyone but you". Count each side as you walk the queue, and you never have to remove yourself from a total.

computeWithPrefixSuffix.summary: prefix[i] = product of everything before i; suffix[i] = product of everything after i.
steps: prefix[0] = 1 (nothing to the left); prefix[i] = prefix[i − 1] × nums[i − 1].
suffix[n − 1] = 1 (nothing to the right); suffix[i] = suffix[i + 1] × nums[i + 1].

computeWithOptimizedSpace.summary: Put the left products in the answer array, then sweep right to left with one running number.
steps: First pass: result[i] = product of everything left of i.
Second pass from the end: result[i] *= right, then right *= nums[i].
computeWithOptimizedSpace.spaceWhy: Only the output array (which doesn't count as extra) and one variable.

computeWithRecursion.summary: Carry the left product down the recursion and return the right product on the way back up.
steps: productRecursive passes left × nums[index] into the next call.
The deepest call returns 1 (nothing to the right of the end).
On the way back, each call sets result[index] = left × productOfRight and returns productOfRight × nums[index].

pitfalls: Dividing the total product by nums[i] is banned, and breaks on zeros anyway.
With one zero, every answer is 0 except at the zero's position; prefix/suffix handles this with no special case.
interview: Explain left × right with a 4-element example on the board; then reduce the space to O(1) by reusing the output array.
Mention that the output array is conventionally not counted as extra space.
